ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping Districts symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 18-B and
20-B in the area bound by:

South Manistee Avenue; East 79" Street; South Burnham Avenue; the alley next
north of and parallel to East 79" Street South Escanaba Avenue; a line 100 feet
south of East 79" Street; South Muskegon Avenue; a line 75 feet south of and
parallel to East 79"" Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Burnham
Avenue; and the alley next south of and parallel to East 79" Street,

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District,

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

“Gréyary eae

Alder man, 7th Ward -
